description: Constructed quality-gate snapshot pairs with expected verdicts. Generated by build_pairs.py; edit that file, not this one.

pairs.name: identical
pairs.description: Same snapshot twice.

pairs.name: visual-real-gain
pairs.description: Mean fidelity +2 pp; the visual judge is deterministic.

pairs.name: visual-below-tolerance
pairs.description: Mean fidelity -0.3 pp, below the 0.5 pp practical tolerance.

pairs.name: visual-color-loss
pairs.description: Color score -1.5 pp.

pairs.name: visual-fail-page
pairs.description: One page moves from PASS to FAIL (FAIL count is lower-is-better).

pairs.name: visual-ink-small
pairs.description: Ink mismatch +0.8 pp, below its 1 pp tolerance.

pairs.name: visual-mismatch-gain
pairs.description: Mismatched pixels -0.4 pp (tolerance 0.1 pp).

pairs.name: perf-large-regression-single-run
pairs.description: Scenario work 100 -> 140 ms in one run each: far beyond the assumed noise (5 % sd per run, threshold about 26 ms).

pairs.name: perf-within-assumed-noise
pairs.description: Scenario work 100 -> 115 ms in one run each: above the 10 % practical tolerance but inside the assumed single-run noise (threshold about 23 ms).

pairs.name: perf-small-gain-detected
pairs.description: Scenario work 20 -> 12 ms: 40 % faster; legacy 10 ms tolerance hid it.

pairs.name: perf-tiny-change
pairs.description: Scenario work 5.0 -> 5.8 ms, below the 1 ms floor.

pairs.name: perf-measured-quiet-regression
pairs.description: Three runs each, sd 1 ms: 100 -> 115 ms is a real regression once the noise is measured.

pairs.name: perf-measured-noisy
pairs.description: Three runs each, sd 30 ms: a 15 ms shift of the mean is inside the measured noise.

pairs.name: perf-measured-quiet-gain
pairs.description: Three runs each, sd 0.5 ms: 20 -> 17 ms is a real gain.

pairs.name: perf-scenario-fail
pairs.description: One more FAIL scenario.

pairs.name: idle-rss-small
pairs.description: Idle RSS +4 MB, below the 5 MB tolerance.

pairs.name: idle-rss-within-noise
pairs.description: Idle RSS +7 MB: above tolerance, inside the assumed noise (2 MB sd, threshold 8.5 MB).

pairs.name: idle-rss-regression
pairs.description: Idle RSS +12 MB.

pairs.name: idle-cpu-gain
pairs.description: Idle CPU 1.0 -> 0.1 %.

pairs.name: compat-one-more-pass
pairs.description: One Test262 test moves from FAIL to PASS (+0.1 pp); legacy 0.5 pp tolerance hid it.

pairs.name: compat-one-regression
pairs.description: One URL case moves from PASS to FAIL.

pairs.name: compat-suite-revision
pairs.description: Test262 checkout moved to another commit; the higher rate is not comparable.

pairs.name: compat-catalog-size
pairs.description: Test262 ran with a --limit: fewer tests, higher rate.

pairs.name: compat-runner-version
pairs.description: URL runner version changed; verdicts may differ for runner reasons.

pairs.name: compat-command
pairs.description: WPT-style command changed (different directories).

pairs.name: visual-catalog-changed
pairs.description: Five pages added to the visual catalog; the mean moves for that reason alone.

pairs.name: visual-reference-changed
pairs.description: Chrome reference upgraded.

pairs.name: environment-changed
pairs.description: Different machine class: every area is not comparable.

pairs.name: engine-changed
pairs.description: Performance measured with QuickJS instead of V8; visual unchanged.

pairs.name: config-viewport-changed
pairs.description: Performance viewport changed.

pairs.name: old-baseline-without-context
pairs.description: The baseline predates context recording; the current run records it, so nothing can be verified.

pairs.name: metric-missing
pairs.description: The current run lost the mismatched-pixel metric.

pairs.name: mixed
pairs.description: Visual improves, performance regresses: a regression is reported.

pairs.name: regression-with-noncomparable-area
pairs.description: A real performance regression while Test262 is not comparable: the regression wins.

pairs.name: gain-with-noncomparable-area
pairs.description: A real visual gain while Test262 is not comparable: no gain is claimed.

pairs.name: gain-and-noise
pairs.description: A real visual gain plus a perf change inside the noise.

pairs.name: no-baseline
pairs.description: No baseline exists.
